runtime_access: deny all on new tables until native application authorization, JSON validation and role policies have been implemented and tested
remaining_transaction_gates: Policy child-list JCS hash, approval roles and immutable published policy/rules
Exactly one selected rule and route/column/matched-rule agreement
Current consent, source visibility, safety-case assignment/release and input/state CAS
Native JSON Schema version dispatch and 256 KiB input limits
Backfill owner/domain and input-message mappings without invented history
Per-role table grants, RLS policies and connection-pool context reset
Receiver identity/signature, handoff audit resource/action/revision, and disclosure authorization; transport receipts never acknowledge a human handoff
Native recommendation/start/save/decline transactions, actual actor confirmation, method applicability and current licensed-source checks
Assessment item ownership, deterministic SCQA subscales and submission/immutable-content transactions
Knowledge release membership/manifest freeze, one method version per stable key, and expert/rights approval
Exercise ID/owner/time provenance backfill and legacy PK cutover before native multiple instances
Real current professional role/credentials/profile/age/region and explicit data sharing at service entry
Appointment root lock, actor/opposite-party acceptance, proposal revision/expiry and range/slot equality; unresolved legacy times block automatic availability claims
Outbox/queue atomicity, destination/purpose recheck, provider signature verification and monotonic receipt aggregation; delivery is not human handoff acceptance
Private people/saved-item ownership and current source access, plus retention policy/custodian approval and archive isolation
Research subject/purpose/session authorization, external requester evidence and current source closure; no imported or approved material is seeded
Asset/case complete-source JCS hashes, acyclic graphs, deidentification review and version freeze before use
Dataset closure/group/split/manifest freeze, late linkage invalidation and withdrawal/erasure propagation
Trusted evaluation provider and reviewer identity, append-only review revisions, hard safety failures and isolated tool substitutes; never publish a model self-grade as expert validation
Bind RecordContent.type to the actual immutable parent kind; sign each exact note version once with current service authority and credential, never infer historical signatures from the mutable root
Freeze recommendation-time profile version, public service snapshot and specialties; apply uses fresh qualifications and terms. Formal feedback maps raw ratings without invented action codes
Follow-up origin is immutable: exact private record version or recipient-bound authorized snapshot; source withdrawal/erasure cancels reminder/context and marks invalidation before controlled cleanup

One physical session has a complete reviewed subject roster; each actual subject needs current purpose/session permission. Freeze sorted participant/role roster in source hashes; withdrawals invalidate every descendant, counts/duration deduplicate by session ID

Freeze each exact asset subject roster in corpus_asset_participants; all native session assets need exactly one primary. Correct current membership only after invalidating old descendants, preserve old frozen rosters and deduplicate call statistics; merge current leakage groups before release.
